title: baphia dewevrei subsp. marceliana
intro: Baphia dewevrei subsp. marceliana, commonly known as Marceliana, is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, primarily used to treat various health conditions, and has been reported to possess anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents present in Marceliana include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation, scavenging free radicals, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Marceliana include its potential to alleviate pain, reduce fever, and treat infections, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
